[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
'''Robert Glasgow''' was born on '''17 June 1848''' in County Antrim, Ireland, the son of [[Glasgow-1049|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Dunseeth-1|Margret Dunseeth]].<ref name="Kendall">George Fisher & Co., ''Biographical Directory of the Voters and Tax-Payers of Kendall County, Illinois'' (Chicago, 1876), entry for Robert Glasgow, Plattville Precinct. [https://libsysdigi.library.uiuc.edu/oca/Books2007-09/biographicaldire00fish/biographicaldire00fish.pdf Digitised copy, University of Illinois Library].</ref>

He appears with his parents in the surviving '''1851 census of Donbought, Dunaghy parish, County Antrim'''. Robert was recorded as their '''two-year-old son'''. His father, also Robert Glasgow, was a forty-year-old linen weaver, while his mother Margaret was aged thirty-seven.<ref name="Donbought">1851 Census of Ireland, County Antrim, barony of Kilconway, parish of Dunaghy, Donbought, household 16. [http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1851/Antrim/Kilconway/Dunaghy/Donbought/16/ National Archives of Ireland, household 16]. See also [https://durrushistory.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/1851irishcensusreturnscommadelimitedtextfilejul24_071.pdf ''1851 Irish Census Returns: comma-delimited transcription''], printed p. 100.</ref>

The census household included Robert's sisters Catherine, Margaret, Maria and Netta, and his older brother whose name has been variously transcribed as Samuel or Daniel. Another sister, Jane, had died in the winter of 1847.<ref name="Donbought" />

=== Immigration to the United States ===

A biographical directory published in Kendall County, Illinois, states that Robert emigrated to the United States on '''8 September 1866'''.<ref name="Kendall" /> He would have been eighteen years old.

The same source records that he came to '''Kendall County, Illinois, on 1 March 1871'''. He subsequently farmed near '''Plattville''', renting an '''80-acre farm in Section 30''' from H. A. Gardner. His religion was recorded as Presbyterian.<ref name="Kendall" />

=== Marriage and family ===

Robert married '''Margaret J. Aiken''', daughter of '''Robert Aiken of County Antrim, Ireland'''.<ref name="Kendall" />

A possible corresponding Illinois marriage record dates the marriage of Robert Glasgow and Margaret Jane Aiken to '''9 June 1870 in Will County, Illinois'''. The indexed bride's surname has also been rendered ''Aron'', so the original record should be inspected before relying on that transcription.

By the time Robert's biography was published in 1876, he and Margaret had '''four children, all living'''.<ref name="Kendall" />

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1049]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The held 1851 Donbought transcription identifies Robert Glasgow as a child of head Robert, with wife Margaret and their 1833 marriage. Robert is the two-year-old son; the held 1876 biography’s 1848 birth fits that childhood entry.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the full original 1851 return with both transcriptions, including relationship headings.

Source basis already held: [http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1851/Antrim/Kilconway/Dunaghy/Donbought/16/ National Archives of Ireland, legacy household locator]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



=== Birth date ===

Robert's age of two in the 1851 Irish census is consistent with a birth in approximately '''1848-1849'''.<ref name="Donbought" /> The later Kendall County biography gives the precise date '''17 June 1848''', which fits the census evidence closely and is therefore used on this profile.<ref name="Kendall" />

=== Parentage ===

Robert's relationship to [[Glasgow-1049|Robert Glasgow]] and Margaret is not based solely on a later family tree. The '''1851 census directly records him in their household as their two-year-old son'''.<ref name="Donbought" />

The census itself records his mother only as '''Margaret Glasgow'''. Her maiden surname of '''Dunseeth/Dunseath''' derives from separate evidence and should therefore be distinguished from the census-supported mother-son relationship.

=== Migration chronology ===

The 1876 biography gives unusually precise dates for Robert's arrival in the United States and Kendall County. These are valuable contemporary biographical statements, although passenger, naturalisation or other immigration records would provide useful independent confirmation.
